summary: E2E frontend validation of Milestone 6 (Cart + Wishlist). All 12 scenarios exercised end-to-end via Playwright against the preview URL. Guest add-to-cart, cart page, qty stepper with stock cap 2, guest persistence, remove/empty state, OOS variant behavior, guest wishlist gating + /wishlist redirect, login and guest-to-auth cart merge, auth wishlist add/remove, i18n RU/UZ/ID/EN, mobile viewport, and zero console errors all validated. One minor prop-forwarding bug in PriceDisplay caused data-testid='cart-subtotal' to be ignored; fixed by testing agent (see updated_files).
action_items: None blocking. Minor: review request references wishlist card testid 'wishlist-muslimah-shop' but actual implementation uses 'wishlist-{slug}' (e.g. 'wishlist-gray-sweat-oversized-full-zip-hoodie'). Update either the request or align testid — code is fine as-is.
PriceDisplay did not forward data-testid prop, so cart-subtotal testid never appeared in DOM. Fixed in /app/frontend/src/components/common/PriceDisplay.jsx by accepting and forwarding data-testid.
critical_code_review_comments: PriceDisplay component previously hardcoded data-testid='price-display' and dropped any data-testid prop passed by parents (e.g. CartPage passes data-testid='cart-subtotal'). Now accepts and forwards data-testid, defaulting to 'price-display'.

Guest 401 responses from /api/auth/me or wishlist endpoints show up as red console errors even though they are expected 'not-signed-in' probes. Consider silencing them (e.g. only call /wishlist when authenticated, or downgrade the log level) — currently they inflate the console-error count and may confuse future test agents. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo customer account and the gray-sweat-oversized-full-zip-hoodie product (Gray/XS stock=2).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Milestone 6 UI is green. Key confirmed behaviors: (1) guest cart via HttpOnly cookie survives reload; (2) plus button becomes is_disabled=True at stock cap; (3) /wishlist and PDP-heart both redirect guests to /login; (4) login merges guest cart correctly (post-merge qty for Gray/XS stays <=2); (5) i18n H1s: Cart -> RU 'Корзина', UZ 'Savat', ID 'Keranjang Belanja', EN 'Shopping Cart'; no raw i18n keys leak; (6) UZS symbol always displayed, no IDR/Rp anywhere; number formatting is locale-aware (RU/EN use comma, ID uses dot). Wishlist grid on 375px viewport = 2 columns (165.5px 165.5px).
